svg.aria-label: What one second of cache costs a reader. A timeline of one second shows the cached answer being built at zero, a write landing at about a fifth of a second in, and every reader after that point receiving the older answer until the window expires. The worst case is marked: a reader can see the feed up to one second out of date, and somebody who has just posted may not see their own post. The caption states that the cost is bounded and nameable, that whether it is acceptable is a product decision rather than a technical one, and that the same cache also caps how much damage a traffic spike can do to the database, so it buys availability as well as speed.
svg.text: WHAT ONE SECOND OF CACHE COSTS A READER
